headlines: Red Cat Reports Q3 2026 Revenue Growth Of 22% Y/Y; YTD Q3 2026 Revenue Growth of 227% Y/Y; Announced Public Purchase to Acquire Steyr Motors AG; and Advancement to Dow Swarm Forge Crucible 4 (StockTitan, 11/16/2026 16:05 ET)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Red Cat reported fiscal Q3 2026 after the Nov 16 close. Revenue was $11.8M, +22% YoY, but gross profit collapsed to $65,000 from $638,000 a year earlier -- a roughly 0.6% gross margin, effectively zero. Net loss widened to $40.448M from $16.017M. Management withdrew the full-year revenue target outright, attributing it to slower funding and contract awards plus the loss of an anticipated revenue contribution following Gauntlet II. Nine-month revenue is still +227% YoY at $47.4M, so the break is the quarter and the forward guide, not the year-to-date trajectory. Cash stood at $242.731M against nine-month operating cash use of $156.844M. Offsetting positives in the same release: Blue Ops received its first U.S. government B-26 purchase order, Apium advanced with Anduril's team to Swarm Forge Crucible 4 with further demonstrations beginning January 2027, Teal Drones and FlightWave were combined under Red Cat Aerial, and the company reiterated its proposed all-cash voluntary public purchase offer for Steyr Motors AG at EUR 39.00/share (28.9% premium to the Oct 16 close, acceptance period ending Dec 18 2026).
gappers.why: The guidance withdrawal plus a near-zero gross margin is the mechanism, not the revenue miss. Pulling the full-year target with one quarter left removes the revenue ramp the equity was priced on, and $65k of gross profit on $11.8M of revenue says the units that did ship carried no contribution -- so the de-rating hits both the growth multiple and the path to operating leverage at once. The Gauntlet II non-contribution deletes the named near-term program catalyst. Forced-seller mechanics then compound it: the stock was already in a steady slide into the print ($4.28 on Nov 11 to $3.525 on Nov 16), and breaking the $3 handle pushes the name out of many funds' and screeners' eligible universes.
gappers.impact: Structural, not a one-day headline spike. A withdrawn full-year guide and a zero gross margin have no same-day repair path, and the move has deepened rather than bounced: -30.03% at the 07:12 ET scan, -32.71% at 08:08 ET, with no sign of a dead-cat bid in that hour. Balance sheet is thinner than the headline cash figure suggests -- $242.7M cash against $156.8M of nine-month operating burn is roughly 14 months of runway at the current rate, before the all-cash Steyr Motors offer consumes more of it, so dilution or a raise is a live risk rather than a remote one. Sector read-through looks contained and idiosyncratic: no other drone/defense name on the watchlist registered even a 1% premarket move, and the whole 69-symbol universe shows only 17 names moving >1%.
gappers.horizon_reasoning: The reset is structural but structurally BEARISH; for a long-biased book the only expression is a days-long oversold bounce, and the name sits far below its 200-SMA, so there is no multi-week long thesis until a contract award or the Steyr close carries a date and a number.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Book is 100% cash -- $100,000 equity, 0 open positions, 0 open orders -- so nothing would be displaced and all 3/3 weekly trade slots are open. The binding constraint is the rulebook, not capacity. RCAT fails on four independent counts: (1) at $2.3754 it is below this routine's own $3.00 price floor; (2) it is far under its 200-SMA, so the long-bias filter blocks any long outright; (3) there is no documented bullish catalyst, so it fails the Confluence rule (>=2 indicators + 1 catalyst); (4) the R:R cannot clear 2:1 at a sane stop -- ATR(14) is $0.385, 10.9% of the Nov 16 close and ~16% of the current price, so a 10% stop at ~$2.14 is only 0.62 ATR, inside a single day's range and certain to be hit before any thesis resolves, while the +20% target at ~$2.85 demands a near-full round trip to yesterday's close within days. The real cost of taking it would be burning one of three weekly slots and up to 20% of equity on a falling knife while trend-aligned names (NBIS +3.3%, SATL +3.3%, BE +2.8%) go untouched. Research only -- no order placed (STEP 8).
